author: IGN
description:
Here's a look at the Evercold Zephyr Job Trailer for Final Fantasy 14, the upcoming expansion to the hit MMO RPG developed by Square Enix. Players can check out one of the two new jobs coming with the expansion: the Zephyr, a physical ranged DPS class that uses crossbow shots and gains support from an avian familiar. Fight as a Zephyr in The Evercold Expansion for Final Fantasy 14, launching on February 23, 2027, for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Mac, and PC (Steam).

author: IGN
description:
What is the best GTA game? Is there more than one S-tier Grand Theft Auto? And who on our IGN panel is most like Trevor? We discuss all that and more with IGN's definitive GTA tier list ranking.

From its humble origins to the juggernaut that is Grand Theft Auto 5, we place every mainline GTA game (sorry, London and Chinatown Wars!) into our very tier list ranking, debating the placement of all the major GTA games with only one caveat: only one GTA game can have an S-tier ranking. That is, until GTA 6 arrives, of course!

Join Simon Cardy, Jim Trinca, and Matt Purslow as they fiercely debate the ranking, making their cases for why some games deserve more praise than others, and why GTA 4 might be underappreciated. Before we get GTA 6, this is IGN's GTA tier list.
title: Which GTA Game is The Best? Let’s Rank Them! - The GTA Tier List
